name: Sunrise Izumo and Sunrise Seto sleeper trains
statusNote: The standard JR release rule, read from JR-WEST's official English page.
howToBuy: The Sunrise Izumo (Tokyo to Izumo) and Sunrise Seto (Tokyo to Takamatsu) are Japan's last regular overnight sleeper trains.
Berths go on sale at 10:00 Japan time one month before the travel date. Book on JR-WEST Online Train Reservation, which is in English.
The private rooms often sell out within minutes of the 10:00 release. Be ready a few minutes early.
rulesToKnow: If the same date doesn't exist in the previous month, sales start on the 1st of the travel month.

soldOut.label: Take the Shinkansen instead: same 10:00 release

faq.q: When can I book the Sunrise Izumo?
faq.a: At 10:00 Japan time, one month before your travel date, on JR-WEST Online Train Reservation.

sources.quote: starting at 10:00 am (JST) on same day of preceding month.
